blocks.title: Derivatives of common functions at x = 1

blocks.question: What is the derivative of f(x) = x⁴ + 3x² − 7?
blocks.explanation: Differentiate term by term: d/dx[x⁴] = 4x³, d/dx[3x²] = 6x, d/dx[−7] = 0. Sum: 4x³ + 6x.

blocks.question: Using the chain rule, what is d/dx[cos(3x)]?
blocks.explanation: Outer function: cos(u), derivative −sin(u). Inner function: 3x, derivative 3. Chain rule: −sin(3x) · 3 = −3 sin(3x).

blocks.question: What rule do you use to differentiate f(x) = x² · sin(x)?
blocks.explanation: When two functions are multiplied together, use the product rule: (uv)' = u'v + uv'.
